verses.text: Icha chi' ix aj sb'atkan winhaj Jacob, ix k'ochkan winh t'a slum heb' winh kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ayik ix k'och winh ta', ix yilanb'at jun ha' uk'b'ila' winh. Ha t'a slak'anil ha' chi', ayek' ox umanh nok' kalnel, yujto ha ha' syuk' nok', ay jun niwan k'een ayoch smakulok sti' ha'.
Ayik smolb'an sb'a masanil nok' kalnel chi' ta', haxo heb' winh stanhwan nok' tz'ik'anel k'een smakul sti' ha' chi', syak'an ha' heb' winh yuk' nok', slajwi chi' smakanxikan sti' ha' heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' tanhwum kalnel chi' icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ayex ex wetanimail? xchi winh. --Ha t'a Harán ayonh, xchi heb' winh.
--¿Eyojtak am winhaj Labán yixchikin winhaj Nacor? xchi winh. --Kojtakton winh, xchi heb'.
--¿Wach' am sk'ol winh eyila'? xchi winh. --Wach' sk'ol winh. Ina a ix Raquel yisil winh wan skot yet' nok' skalnel chi', xchi heb' winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Jacob chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ayto k'u, ¿tas yuj manh tonhejok tzeyak' yuk'a' nok' he kalnel tik, tze tanhwan wa jab'okxo nok'? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalan heb' winh: --Max yal-laj, yowalil sko tanhwej smolb'an sb'a nok' smasanil, ichato chi' ol kik'anel k'een niwan smakul sti' ha' tik, yik syal yuk'an ha' nok' smasanil, xchi heb'.
Wanto slolon winhaj Jacob chi' yet' heb' winh, ix ja ix Raquel yet' nok' yik winh smam, yujto a ix stanhwan nok'.

Ayik ix yilan winh sja ix yet' nok' yik winh smam chi', haton winh snulej ix snun winh, elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj winh, ix yik'anel k'een smakul sti' ha ha' chi' winh, ix yak'an yuk' ha' nok' kalnel chi' winh.
T'a elanhchamel ix yak'an stzatzil sk'ol ix Raquel chi' winh, ix tz'ub'elta sti' ix winh, ix ok'k'e winh.
Ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik: Yune' in ix Rebeca, ix yanab' winh a mam, xchi winh. Axo ix yab'an ix Raquel icha chi', ix b'at lemnaj ix yal t'a winh smam chi'.

Axo ix yab'an winhaj Labán sb'inaj winhaj Jacob yune' yanab', ix b'at lemnaj winh schakot winh. Ix och lak'naj winh t'a winh, ix tz'ub'anelta sti' winh, ix yik'anb'at winh winh t'a spat chi'. Ix och ijan winhaj Jacob chi' yalani tas ix aj skoti.
Ix yalan winhaj Labán chi' t'a winh icha tik: Wal yel te a onhto och et'ok, xchi winh. Jun ujal ix kan winh yet' winhaj Labán chi'.

Ayik ix ek' jun uj chi', ix yalan winhaj Labán chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tiknaik wach'chom ayto kuj ko b'a, palta max yal-laj nab'anhej ol ach munlaj t'ayin. Al t'ayin jantak ol ach in tupu', xchi winh.
Ay chawanh yisil winhaj Labán chi': Ha ix b'ab'el, Lea sb'i ix, haxo ix schab'il Raquel.
Ha ix Lea chi', icha yilji taxon heb' ix ix yilji ix, anhej yol sat ix wach' yilji. Axo pax ix Raquel jun, te wach' yilji sat ix yet' sniwanil smasanil.
Axo winhaj Jacob chi', ix kan snib'ej winh t'a ix Raquel chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: --Tzin kan ukeok ab'il in kaj ix Raquel, ix chab'il isil tik, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Labán chi': --Kananh, wach' ol wak' ix t'ayach, ¿tas gana ch'ok b'aj swak' ix? xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj skajan uke' ab'il ix winh. Maj yab' winh yek' jun pekti' chi', yujto te ay snib'ej winh t'a ix.
Axo yik ix ek' uke' ab'il chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Labán chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, ix lajwi ko trato yik tzin kaj ix. Ak' ix wetb'eyumok yik swik'an in b'a yet' ix, xchi winh.
Axo winhaj Labán chi' ix awtankot masanil heb' kajan t'a slak'anil chi', ix yak'anoch sq'uinhal snupnajel ix yisil winh chi'.
Ayik toxo ix k'e ak'wal ix yik'ankot ix Lea winhaj Labán t'a winhaj Jacob chi', ix way winh yet' ix.
Ix ak'ji jun skriada ix yuj winhaj Labán chi', a ix chi' Zilpa sb'i ix.

Ayik ix sakb'i, ix yilanelta winhaj Jacob chi' to a ix Lea ix way yet' winh, ix b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Labán chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj icha tik ix in utej? Ha ix Raquel ix in kaj t'ayach, ¿tas yuj tzin ixtej? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Labán chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha ko b'eyb'al t'a ko kal tik, max yal-laj to a ix tzak'anto sb'ab'laj och winh yetb'eyum t'a ix b'ab'el.
k'anab'ajejkan jun semana sq'uinh nupnajel yik ix Lea tik, ol ik'anpax ix Raquel chi' tato tzak' a ti' a kajan ukeokxo ab'il ix t'ayin, xchi winhaj Labán chi'.
Ix schaan sk'ol winhaj Jacob jun lolonel chi'. Ix sk'anab'ajan jun semana q'uinh nupnajel winh yet' ix Lea chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anpax ix Raquel winhaj Labán chi' yik tz'och ix yetb'eyumok winh.
Ix yak'anpax jun ix skriada ix Raquel chi' winh haton ix Bilha.
Ix yik'lan sb'a winhaj Jacob yet' ix Raquel chi', yelxo wal xajanab'il ix aj ix yuj winh t'a yichanh ix Lea chi'. Yuj chi' uketo ab'il ix skaj ix winh.
Ayik ix yilan Jehová to chab'k'olab'il ix Lea chi', ix yak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh ix yik tz'aj yune' ix. Axo pax ix Raquel, malaj yune' ix.
Axo ix Lea chi', ix och ix yab'ixal, ix alji jun yune' ix, Rubén ix yak' ix sb'iej, ix yalan ix: Ha Jehová ix yila' to patikab'il in el yuj winh wetb'eyum, haxo tiknaik xajan ol in yil winh, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi' ix alji junxo yune' ix, Simeón ix yak' ix sb'iej, ix yalan ix icha tik: Ix yab' Jehová to chab'k'olab'il waji, yuj chi' ix yak' junxo wune' tik, xchi ix.
Ix aljipax junxo yune' ix, Leví ix yak' ix sb'iej, ix yalan ix: Ha tiknaik junxonhej ol aj winh wetb'eyum tik wet'ok, yujto oxwanhxo wune' yet' winh, xchi ix.
Ix alji junxo yune' ix, Judá ix yak' ix sb'iej, ix yalanpax ix: Ha tiknaik, swik'chaanh sb'i Jehová, xchi ix. Axonhej chi', ix och waan yilan sat unin ix.
